title: GroupPatchInput
description: The fields that can be specified when partially updating a group.

name.description:
The group's new name. Cannot be empty or `null`, and must be
at most 4096 characters. Names must be unique, except for
SAML, OAuth2, and Proxied authentication when `GroupsByUniqueId`
is enabled.

owner_guid.description:
The new owner's unique identifier. Must reference an existing
user who is not a viewer. Can be set to `null` to remove the
owner for SAML, OAuth2, and Proxied authentication when
`GroupsAutoProvision` is enabled.

gid.description:
The POSIX Group ID (GID) for
[current user execution](../admin/process-management/index.md#runas-current).
Must be a positive integer and unique across all groups. Set
to `null` to remove the GID.
